clues.title: Extract from Enzo's will
clues.text:
I, Enzo Marchetti, leave the estate to my three children in equal parts: **Luca**, **Sofia** and my youngest, **Giulia**, born of my marriage to my beloved wife **Rosa**.

To **Clara**, who was my wife for nineteen years before our divorce, I leave the painting she always admired.

clues.title: Wedding announcement, 1998
clues.text: **Marchetti — Vitale.** Sofia Marchetti, daughter of Enzo and Clara Marchetti, married Marco Vitale on Saturday at San Lorenzo. The couple will live in Turin.

clues.title: Birthday photo
clues.description: Little Elena blowing out six candles. Written on the back: *Our daughter, 2006 — Sofia & Marco.*

clues.title: Voicemail from Luca
clues.description: A message left on Enzo's phone.
clues.transcript: Dad, it's Luca. Nina and I are coming for dinner on Sunday. No, we're not getting married, stop asking — we're happy as we are. And yes, her divorce from Tommaso is final now, so you can stop worrying about that too.

clues.title: Interview with Clara
clues.transcript: Interviewer: You were married to Enzo for nearly twenty years. Clara: Nineteen. We had Luca first, then Sofia. After the divorce he married Rosa Bellini within the year. I hear they have a little girl now.
